scope: Same optimized diagnostic binary, exact production Metal, same Qwen model/precision/layout/prompts/serving/resources. Fresh A1 B1 B2 A2, one short conditioning and one loaded request per process; only existing forced TK1 selection differs. Debug/pilot/previous release timing rows are excluded.
required_observables: exact existing B1 greedy text/count/finish for both contexts, actual BF16 kernel and padded strides, unchanged15 files pre/post per process, same artifact/Metal, live resource gates and owned exit
decision: To treat this as a candidate fix for the observed loaded decode gap, both optimized forced process TPS values must exceed both controls and their equal-weight mean gain must at least match the computed recovery effect. This is a practical recovery check, not statistical significance. If it meets the check, complete the bounded range and production-policy review; otherwise do not add a production selector on this evidence. Always report wall time and backend prefill separately; even a decode recovery does not resolve the remaining whole-request finding.
